abstract: Surgery combined with chemotherapy was applied in 34 out of 178 patients (19.1%) with GTD during treatment at the Institute of Oncology in Warsaw in the years 1977-1989. This mode of treatment was used twice as often in patients with MTD (Metastatic Tumour Disease) (31.6%) than in those with NMTD (Non Metastatic Tumour Disease) (14.2%). All 34 patients, who were operated on, had hysterectomy and 3 of them thoracotomy also. The most common indication for surgery was the chemoresistance of the disease, which had been stated in 53% of all treated surgically. All the patients with NMTD and those with good prognosis MTD, treated by combination of chemotherapy and surgery were cured, which confirms the efficacy of adjuvant surgery in these groups of patients. The role of surgery in patients with high-risk MTD is limited because of disseminated disease, frequently seen in this group.
abstract_ja: 1977年から1989年にワルシャワの腫瘍学研究所で治療を受けた妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）178例のうち、34例（19.1%）に手術と化学療法が併用された。この治療法は、MTD（転移性腫瘍疾患）の患者（31.6%）では、NMTD（非転移性腫瘍疾患）の患者（14.2%）の2倍の頻度で用いられた。手術を受けた34例全例で子宮摘出術が施行され、そのうち3例では開胸術も施行された。手術の最も多い適応は化学抵抗性であり、外科的治療を受けた全患者の53%で認められた。化学療法と手術の併用療法を受けたNMTDの全患者と、予後良好なMTDの患者は全員治癒し、これらの群における補助的手術の有効性が裏付けられた。高リスクのMTDの患者では、この群に多くみられる播種性疾患のため、手術の役割は限られている。
